label: Yellow
source_name: Franklin County Board of County Commissioners / Parks & Recreation
official_authority: Franklin County Board of County Commissioners / Parks & Recreation
method: Direct official current-condition terminology normalized under Florida Beach Warning Flag definitions
source_note: Franklin County publishes current beach conditions directly; NWS Tallahassee provides a corroborating flag reported by area beach officials.
safety_note: Know the Gulf displays only explicit flags from local authorities or an NWS product that says the flag was reported by area beach officials. Forecast risk is never converted into a flag.
flag_schema: Florida Beach Warning Flag terminology v1
flag_terms_note: Official current wording is normalized as: Water Closed to Public=Double Red; High Hazard or High Surf and/or Currents=Red; Medium/Moderate Hazard or Moderate Surf and/or Currents=Yellow; Low Hazard or Calm Conditions, Exercise Caution=Green; Dangerous Marine Life=Purple. Purple is an independent overlay. Forecast rip-current risk is not converted into a flag.
terminology_evidence: current-text:Medium Hazard; Moderate Surf and/or Currents
